description: This file contains unit tests for the Prop class within the Vue component of the OrangeHRM project. It verifies the behavior of property setting, type handling, and value serialization.

classes.name: PropTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the Prop class in the Vue component.

methods.name: testProp

methods.name: testPropWithValue
methods.description: Tests the Prop class's handling of different data types and serialization of raw values and display values.
